issues.claim: Monroe Wealth Management (monroewm.com) is a Monroe Township, NJ financial planning practice
issues.problem: Contradicted. The firm is Monroe Wealth Management LLC, 1160 Battery St, Suite 100, San Francisco, CA 94111. The owner's SEC/FINRA IAPD record (Glen Eric Monroe, CRD 6265422) gives San Francisco as the firm's main address and only branch, and its Thumbtack listing says it serves San Francisco, CA. 'Monroe' is the owner's surname, not the township. It is an out-of-state business, not in the zone.

issues.claim: Dollar Tax Savers LLC (1197 Morning Glory Dr, Monroe Township) is a Monroe Township accounting practice
issues.problem: Contradicted. The firm's own site describes it as a 'CPA Firm - North Brunswick, NJ' and its contact page gives 1547B Finnegan Lane, North Brunswick, NJ 08902. 1197 Morning Glory Dr is a residential street in Monroe Township, but nothing on the firm's site ties its office to Monroe; the Monroe address looks like a stale directory record.
issues.fix: Remove, or re-verify with the firm; the operating office is North Brunswick, outside the zone.

issues.claim: PMI Turn Key NJ (monroepropertymanagementinc.com) as an eligible independent property-management business
issues.problem: This is a franchise office of the national PMI (Property Management Inc.) brand - the site carries the PMI brand promise, PMI awards and PMI-branded resources. The mapper's own caveat says branded franchise locations were excluded, so an excluded franchise remains in the list.
issues.fix: Remove per the franchise exclusion, or get the zone owner's explicit approval to keep franchise-branded locally owned offices and apply it consistently.

issues.claim: American Residential Mortgage, 8 Centre Dr, Suite 100, Monroe Township
issues.problem: Not confirmed as currently operating. The only supporting source is a bulk directory; HUD records show a branch of this name at that address with status terminated effective 13 Nov 2006, and no current web presence or licence record was found.
issues.fix: Drop unless a current source (state licence, own site, or a recent filing) can be found.

issues.claim: Zone coverage of consulting engineering firms
issues.problem: My own search surfaced JWP Engineering, 7 Centre Dr, Suite 8, Monroe Township NJ 08831 (civil engineering / construction management), which is not on the list even though three other Monroe consulting engineers are.
issues.fix: Add JWP Engineering (7 Centre Dr, Suite 8; 609-655-4400) after confirming it is active.

issues.claim: Several entries rest on name-only inference or an unconfirmed address
issues.problem: Monroe Wealth Management was kept on a name-only inference, which is exactly the failure mode that produces wrong-town entries. The same weakness applies to Brandarrow Agency (own site would not load), The Awerbuch Group (its about page presents the agency as virtual and as 'T.A.G. Insurance Advisors', with no Monroe address) and Baseline Consulting (own site shows an NJ office and a Florida office but no address). Handex Consulting & Remediation at 24 Abeel Rd appears only in a 2010 NJ DOT roster, so currency is unproven.
issues.fix: Require a town-level source (own-site address, SEC/state filing, or municipal record) for any entry whose only match is the firm name or a search snippet; demote the rest to a 'verify first' bucket.
